purpose: Collection requirements only; not operational records or owner approval
scope: OP1 / one zone / one building / technical
basis: vinhomes_api.owner_bundle schema v2 and the current missing-data.csv

shared_review_fields.approved_by: Actual authorized data owner or delegate; do not replace with the software administrator or a generated name.
shared_review_fields.approved_at: Actual approval timestamp with timezone, not in the future.
shared_review_fields.effective_from: Actual effective timestamp with timezone, not in the future; a historical construction acceptance date does not establish a current service policy.

missing_field_requirements.owner_records: Provide the complete authorized dataset with the exact CSV header; an empty dataset is not one missing person or document.
missing_field_requirements.operator_code: Use the same confirmed operator identifier in operators, geography, coverage, staff and services; a developer's public corporate identity does not establish current operating responsibility.
missing_field_requirements.current_address: Owner-confirmed current administrative address for the selected zone/building; do not infer it from the 2020 or 2022 documents.
missing_field_requirements.platform_route_id: Route identifier agreed with the actual Platform endpoint for this scope and technical category; a proposed or sandbox route is not a live route.
missing_field_requirements.route_revision: Positive integer matching the revision agreed by both backends.
missing_field_requirements.eligibility: Confirmed eligible requesters, asset types, private/common areas and access requirements; residency authorization must remain enforced by Domain.
missing_field_requirements.fee_policy: Owner selects free, fixed or quote. Free requires fee_amount=0; fixed requires a finite nonnegative amount; quote requires an empty amount and an approved quotation before chargeable work.
missing_field_requirements.fee_unit: Confirmed billing unit such as job or hour; do not choose a billing model from a marketing article.
missing_field_requirements.vat_policy: Owner-confirmed treatment of VAT in the applicable quote or published tariff; do not generate a tax rate or claim tax inclusion without evidence.
missing_field_requirements.operating_hours: Confirmed service calendar, timezone, holidays and emergency coverage; a recruitment schedule is not a staff roster or service opening time.
missing_field_requirements.warranty_policy: Correct property/device scope, provider, start/end evidence, exclusions and contact; a commercial-unit template does not establish residential warranty rights.
missing_field_requirements.booking_policy: Confirmed appointment, access consent, lead time and availability rules; an appointment must not be promised before actual acceptance.
missing_field_requirements.cancellation_policy: Confirmed cancellation/rebooking rules and any fees, including who can authorize them.
missing_field_requirements.contact_reference: Reference to the confirmed operating contact/team, not a recruiting or sales contact and not a generated telephone number.
missing_field_requirements.priority: Owner-approved classification: low, normal, high or critical. The classification needs a matching escalation and handling policy.
missing_field_requirements.response_minutes: Owner-approved positive integer in elapsed minutes; must not exceed resolution_minutes. An authored proposal is not an agreed SLA.
missing_field_requirements.resolution_minutes: Owner-approved positive integer in elapsed minutes, at least response_minutes; define the event that starts/stops the clock before activation.
missing_field_requirements.safety_policy: Approved SOP for the exact incident and qualified role, access/stop-work conditions and emergency handling. Public handover specifications are not repair instructions.
missing_field_requirements.escalation_policy: Confirmed trigger, recipient, fallback and authority for safety, unavailable staff, delays and unresolved incidents; do not add Domain BQL ticket approval.

operators.source: Operating appointment/contract and authorized contact register

zones.source: Confirmed zone master and current administrative address

buildings.source: Confirmed building master and operator scope; public technical aliases can support reconciliation

units.source: Authorized unit/lot master; do not generate unit numbers from floor counts

coverage.source: Confirmed operating scope and Platform routing contract

residents.source: Authorized verified residency extract; no passwords or identity-document images

staff.source: Authorized roster, qualification, assignment, capacity and backup register
staff.constraint: Primary and backup are distinct employees with matching operator, scope and specialty. Resident and staff logins must be distinct in this pilot.

shifts.source: Approved real shift schedule with timezone and backup coverage
shifts.constraint: Each employee has a valid shift; backup covers the primary shift; one employee cannot have overlapping shifts.

services.source: Approved service catalog, eligibility, tariff/quote rules, schedule and warranty/booking/cancellation policies

sops.source: Approved resident/staff SOPs for each service, including safety, escalation and acceptance/SLA definitions

handoff_rules.all_rows: Exact CSV schema plus document_reference, approved_by, approved_at, effective_from and effective_until; source evidence must match the manifest SHA-256.
handoff_rules.privacy: Owner files stay private outside Git; Platform receives ticket context and scoped MCP access, not bulk residency/identity files.
handoff_rules.synthetic: Requires explicit synthetic_test labeling and an isolated owner_pilot_test database; never replace production records or impersonate operator approval.
handoff_rules.activation: Validation/staging does not activate master data, accounts, staff, routing or knowledge; publication and real integration require separate verification.

additional_runtime_prerequisites.verified_contact_directory: Before publishing real resident accounts, provide an authorized contact directory linked by account_code, verified contact number and verification evidence/effective dates. The current CSV v2 does not carry a phone field; do not infer a real phone or generate a Vietnamese subscriber number. Sandbox materialization uses a clearly synthetic NANPA contact fixture only.
